introBody:
In every story, you become the main character.

Your goal is to choose what that character actually did according to the Bible.

Sometimes the biblical answer may not be the morally "best" choice—it is simply the one that matches the biblical account.

At the end of each story, you'll receive a Biblical Accuracy score and a star rating.

Can you reach 100% Biblical Accuracy?

Good luck!
